description: This file contains component functions related to password block options and dynamic password generation within a block picker plugin for a lexical-based editor. It defines functions to retrieve password block options and generate new password blocks based on user query input.

methods.name: GetPasswordBlockOption
methods.description: Constructs a BlockPickerOption for the password block with specified properties and icon, based on the current password block obtained from the editor.

methods.name: GetDynamicPasswordBlocks
methods.description: Generates password block options based on user input query string, supporting length validation and command dispatch for password generation.
